HERO.TITLE: Websites that work for your business.
HERO.SUBTITLE: Custom websites and web apps built with Angular — fast, secure, mobile-optimised, without page-builder compromises.

SERVICES.TITLE: What I offer
SERVICES.INTRO: From first idea to running application.
SERVICES.ITEM_1_TEXT: Built from scratch, not from a template — fitted to your business, not a mould.
SERVICES.ITEM_1_DETAIL: From concept to go-live: structure, copy polish and technical build from a single hand. No page builder, no off-the-shelf theme.
SERVICES.ITEM_2_TEXT: Modernise an existing site: faster, clearer, easier for your customers to understand — accessible to WCAG standards and fully data-protection compliant.
SERVICES.ITEM_2_DETAIL: I take over existing content, clear out what no longer works, and rebuild on a clean technical foundation — without you starting from zero.
SERVICES.ITEM_3_TEXT: Management tools, customer portals and forms that reflect real workflows, not just good looks.
SERVICES.ITEM_3_DETAIL: From customer management to a customer portal: tools that genuinely simplify your day-to-day, not just a feature checklist.
SERVICES.ITEM_4_TEXT: Set up to Swiss data protection standards, documented clearly, maintainable long-term.
SERVICES.ITEM_4_DETAIL: Server location, data minimisation, imprint and privacy policy — considered from day one, not bolted on afterwards.

WORK.TITLE: Selected work
WORK.INTRO: Two projects, two completely different sets of requirements.
WORK.SHM_TEXT: A management application for second-hand and consignment shops: customers, inventory, commissions, finances and a customer portal in one system.
WORK.DUNE_TEXT: Website for a second-hand boutique in the Jura region — with a built-in content management system so the owner can maintain content herself.
